verdict.rationale: Featurebase confirms it has a dedicated API Reference tab with full HTTP/SDK docs and detailed endpoint-level guides (e.g. posts, help-center editing endpoints), showing a real reference exists, but there is no evidence of interactive 'try-it' runnable examples, code sandboxes, or an accessible OpenAPI/Swagger spec — probes for standard openapi.json/swagger.json paths all 404.
